headline: A CNET writer's test found that Meta's Muse AI agent could not sort out a phone-number problem alone because websites blocked it.
score_reason: Pool score kept: one writer's anecdotal test, mildly informative.
importance_line: It shows AI agents still often stall when websites block bots, which affects anyone hoping an agent will handle chores, with the doubt that it is a single anecdotal test.
summary: CNET reports, in a first-person test, that Meta's Muse AI agent failed to confirm who owns the writer's Visible phone number, which keeps receiving spam meant for a previous owner called Andrew, because Visible and other sites blocked bot visits. The writer concludes that Muse still works more like a regular chatbot that gives advice, because many websites block AI agents.
notes: Single first-person test; Visible is Verizon's low-cost all-digital plan per the article.
